summary.what_it_does: Cursor is presented as a coding agent for building software. Agents can take a task, use their own computers to build and test a feature end to end, and return the work for review. The product is offered in several places: a desktop IDE, a CLI installed with a curl script, Slack integration, and GitHub pull request review. The page says users can pick from several frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and others, and can launch fleets of agents that run in parallel for hours or days. It also mentions an Agent SDK and AI bots that can sign into tools and work inside them.
notable: Agents run on their own computers to build, test, and demo features for review
Choice of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Cursor
Runs parallel agent fleets for long tasks
Integrates with terminal, Slack and GitHub PR review
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform list is not explicitly given beyond the desktop, CLI, Slack and GitHub mentions
Page is mostly marketing copy with few technical details
